method: Two independently submitted exploratory queries in a signed-out Perplexity session. Screenshots are original browser captures. Findings describe these observations only; search answers vary by date, service and context. Public session URLs may expire or require sign-in; preserved captures are the durable reference.

queries.query: Who supplies automated bagging equipment for hardware kits?
observed: PAC Machinery appears in the supplier answer.
The cited PAC example is a Rollbag R1275 integrated kitting system, not evidence of the R3200 configuration.

sources.name: Packaging World · PAC / MSD kitting system

queries.model: Default selector; model name not exposed

queries.query: What should I compare when choosing an automatic bagger for manually loaded hardware kits?
observed: The answer emphasizes the operator workflow, usable bag opening, package quality and representative trials.
A PAC automatic-bagger guide appears in the retrieved source list. This does not mean it was the sole source of the answer.
queries.model: Default selector; model name not exposed

sharedExample.title: Medical packaging companies
sharedExample.model: Not exposed in the shared page
sharedExample.query: I'm looking for packaging equipment for a medical application, who is a good company to contact about that
observed: The answer names MULTIVAC, Ossid, Belco Packaging Systems and SelectSeal Packaging Machinery.
PAC is not among those four suppliers in this shared answer.
limits: One shared answer is not an audit of PAC visibility.
Our separate hardware-kit searches did surface PAC.
This observation does not establish why ChatGPT selected these suppliers.
The hardware-kit R3200 demo is a separate illustrative application.

leadCaptureExample.title: Packaging Equipment Search
leadCaptureExample.query: I'm looking for packaging equipment for my manufacturing company
observed: The initial answer already recommends PAC alongside other suppliers.
The page asks about packaging type, industry and automation.
The later explicit prompt specifies shrink packaging, medical industry and manual operation.
The resulting shortlist includes PAC / Clamco Dempack H30 One Step and 4C Combo, with links to PAC product pages.
limits: One search interaction is not a visibility audit or evidence of conversion or sales growth.
The displayed form defaults differ from the later explicit prompt. No controls were changed and no reproduction of the original submission is claimed.
AI machine recommendations are not verified PAC suitability or compliance decisions.
The proposed inquiry summary uses an illustrative product selection; it is not an actual buyer submission.
The later Harbor / R3200 scenario is a separate illustrative sales case.

sources.name: Dempack H30 product page and Instant Quote

websiteCheck.observed: The general quote request and product-page Instant Quote entry both exist. The visible Instant Quote form collects contact information and a free-text application description.
websiteCheck.limits: No submission was made. Backend handling and retained product metadata were not inspected. This is not evidence that product context is lost.
